plannedAsset.nextGate: Retain collection ownership transfer, partial-field siblings, skipped loops, repeated iterations, negative ownership diagnostics, full native regression and changed-source Windows Stage2/Stage3.

decision.reason: Collection insertion MoveEvent collection accepts owned names but omits owned member projections. Newly reachable loop cleanup drops the complete source aggregate after its field has moved into a collection, causing use-after-free and duplicate release. Isolated v13 records projected insertion moves, preserving cleanup of unmoved siblings.
